name: rapid feature-name montage with a corner progress HUD
looks: A run of short feature names hard-cuts one per beat, each on its own field colour and its own kind of entrance: plain bold on white, an outline face on black, a motion-blurred slam on a bright colour, neon text with small particles falling behind it. A small counter and a category tag sit in the corners throughout, ticking up with each cut.
build: One clip per word, cut exactly on the beat; each field gets its own treatment (solid colour, outline stroke, falling-particle backdrop); the corner HUD (scene counter top right, section tag bottom left) updates from the clock with no easing, same mechanic as hud-frame.
sound: A hit on every cut, pitched slightly differently per field colour.
prompt: Hard-cut through a short run of feature names, one per beat, giving each its own field colour and its own kind of entrance so the run shows range, while a small counter and category tag sit quietly in the corners the whole time, ticking with every cut.
